editorial.blurb: Tacos El Tio serves authentically crafted Mexican fare with meats seasoned to perfection and homemade tortillas that keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Come late—reviewers rave about the carne asada, pastor, and pollo tacos hitting their stride around midnight, and don't skip the caldo de res for colder nights.

topDishes.note: seasoned to perfection with off-the-chain texture
rotisserie-cooked with pineapple on top, rich and juicy
special red spicy broth loaded with vegetables and handmade corn tortillas
